bias.label: Leaning down below 3,830-3,850; new one-year low

event: FOMC minutes today, Wed 18 Nov, at 21:00 SAST (2 p.m. US Eastern).

bullets.title: Fresh one-year low
bullets.text: Gold fell about 0.8% in Asian trade to roughly 3,815-3,821, under Monday's 3,830 low and its lowest since early October 2025 (exact quote time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Support broke
bullets.text: The 3,830-3,843 zone that held all of Tuesday has given way, so it now acts as resistance on any bounce.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch odds for a December quarter-point hike are about 93-96% across sources, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Dollar near highs
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 103.7, near a 19-month high, and US yields are about 5.12% (10-year, per a 16 Nov snapshot).

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed talk
bullets.text: Musalem backs several more hikes and Hammack favours steady hikes, while Williams says no dramatic action is needed.

bullets.title: Minutes tonight
bullets.text: The October FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast in either direction.

levels.note: Monday's low, now broken and overhead

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,780-3,800 (counter-trend)
look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping into 3,780-3,800 and holding, not slicing through.
A 15M close back above 3,805 after the dip.
The dollar easing from 103.7 and yields slipping.
Take some profit at 3,830 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying a falling price before it shows a hold. Wait for the 15M close above 3,805.
A 1H close under 3,775 can run toward 3,730.
Hawkish FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can break support fast. Avoid entering in the 15 minutes before.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,830-3,850
look: Price bouncing back up into 3,830-3,850 and stalling there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close back under 3,830.
The dollar firm near 103.7 and yields near 5.1%.
Take some profit at 3,800 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 3,817 after the drop. That is chasing; wait for a bounce to 3,830-3,850.
FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can cause a sharp spike either way. Avoid entering in the 15 minutes before.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
